title: Government Of India Act 1919
definition: Also known as the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms, the Government of India Act 1919 was an Act of the British Parliament enacted to expand the participation of Indians in the administration of their country.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC CSE Prelims for specific structural changes (Dyarchy, bicameralism, direct elections) and in Mains GS Paper 2 for the evolution of the Indian Constitution and the transition from responsible governance to provincial autonomy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Government Of India Act 1919.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
